Kernel release and boot identity pinned; probe SHA256 checked before/after. Existing regular target requires mmcblk0p4; outer dev/inode/size/mtime stable before/after and accurately labelled preflight identity.
Matches actual driver read-only schema and includes all segment/CPU rows; rejects missing, duplicate, malformed/negative counter rows and mismatched request/CPU/poll sums.
